g.title: Sheet.132
g.desc: What if the server uses 10.1.1.2 as a default gateway and R1 ...
g.text: The server uses the virtual IP address (VIP) as a default gateway.

g.title: Sheet.133
g.desc: What if the server uses 10.1.1.2 as a default gateway and R1 ...
g.text: The routers run VRRP and share a virtual router group address.If one router fails, the other one takes over the VIP.
